summary: IndexTTS-2 / indextts2-v1 bills per delivered audio second at AutoDL's own audio_sec_cost rate (CNY 0.001/s), with AutoDL's minimum (CNY 0.010, i.e. the first 10 seconds) enforced in the plugin. The model marketplace shows a single rate expression it can actually render.

official_billing.unit_scale: raw x 0.001 = CNY (cross-checked on wan: raw video_sec_cost.price 40 -> live expression uses 0.04)
official_billing.arithmetic: 0.001 CNY/s x 10 s = 0.01 CNY, which is exactly what minimum_price denotes, so the minimum is the first 10 seconds

marketplace_display.problem: the TTS price did not render in the model marketplace ('expression cannot be parsed')
investigation: dumped all live billing expressions: 65 distinct, of which 6 MiniMax H3 models use nested ternaries and render correctly, so nesting alone is not the cause
the only expression containing max() in the whole deployment was the TTS one just written
A/B against the live marketplace: the single-level hour(...) ? tier(...) : tier(...) form renders; the nested form did not, twice
marketplace_display.resolution: published expression is now the single-level two-rate form, identical in shape to wan2.2-animate-move
marketplace_display.minimum_relocated: because the renderer cannot express the minimum, the plugin floors the settled seconds at 10 (both while polling and at settlement), so the charge still matches AutoDL's minimum exactly while the displayed rate stays truthful
marketplace_display.scope_of_the_rule: the strict single-`?` rule is asserted only for IndexTTS-2, where it was proven; H3 models keep their nested ternaries, which do render

implementation.measurement: bounded Range read of the delivered file; WAV via RIFF fmt/data chunks (little-endian), MP3 via Xing/Info frame count; falls back to the reservation when unmeasurable
implementation.never_billed: upstream data.duration, which is render wall time

live_paid_task.interpretation: 0.01 CNY / 0.001 per second = 10 s, i.e. the vendor minimum was applied exactly; a per-request price would have been 0.5 CNY (quota 250000)

regression_protection.method: revert each part of the change and confirm the suite fails
reverts: bill TTS per request again (give it no seconds input)
read WAV fields big-endian again (the parsing bug)
trust the header byteRate without a bounds-checked data chunk
stop measuring the delivered audio at settlement
drop the saved-type fallback for unmapped names
give TTS the motion 5-second reservation instead of the vendor minimum
omit the TTS reservation when replaying an OpenAI-style body
stop enforcing the vendor minimum at settlement
stop enforcing the vendor minimum while polling
